metadata.question: Was the area of forest cover between the Ucayali and Genepanshea Rivers larger along UC-105, at 5 km radius around center (-9.799994, -73.845369), on August 21, 2022 than on August 23, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Global Forest Cover (Hansen dataset) v1.9 for tree cover data at 30m resolution. - Date: We need two snapshots: 2017-08-23 and 2022-08-21. While Hansen dataset is annual composites, we'll use the treecover2000 band and its loss/gain bands to compute cumulative cover up to the target years. - Location: 5 km buffer around (-9.799994, -73.845369) and intersect with the watershed polygon band (UC-105) between Ucayali and Genepanshea Rivers. 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for Hansen treecover. Apply the watersheds layer and buffer to mask out irrelevant areas. 3. Logic: - Compute treecover in the target zone on both dates (2017 and 2022), expressed in hectares. - If any collection size is zero return C1. - If valid pixel count after masking is zero return C2. - If hectares are None, nan, negative or > 500000 return C3. - Else higher is Yes (A), else No (B). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Compute results sum17 = cover2017.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=mask, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get("treecover2000").getInfo() sum22 = cover2022.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=mask, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get("treecover2000").getInfo() # validation counts count17 = cover2017.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=mask, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get("treecover2000").getInfo() count22 = cover2022.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=mask, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get("treecover2000").getInfo() print(f"2022 forest cover (ha): {sum22:.2f}, Valid pixels: {int(count22)}") print(f"2017 forest cover (ha): {sum17:.2f}, Valid pixels: {int(count17)}") # 4. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.845369, -9.799994]).buffer(5000)
# squeeze the watershed band to the UC-105 area
watershed = ee.Image("WWF/HydroSHEDS/v1/FreeDrainingBasins")
uc105 = watershed.eq(105)
# combine buffer and watershed mask
mask = pt.intersection(uc105.geometry(), 10)

# 2. Data Acquisition & Initial Check
hansen = ee.Image("UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2022_v1_9")
base = hansen.select(["treecover2000"]).multiply(0.01).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(10000)  # hectares
loss17 = hansen.select(["lossyear"]).lte(17).And(hansen.select(["lossyear"]).gte(1))
loss22 = hansen.select(["lossyear"]).lte(22).And(hansen.select(["lossyear"]).gte(1))
gain = hansen.select(["gain"]).eq(1)
# compute cover as base - loss + gain
cover2017 = base.subtract(loss17.multiply(base)).add(gain.multiply(0.01)).updateMask(mask)
cover2022 = base.subtract(loss22.multiply(base)).add(gain.multiply(0.01)).updateMask(mask)

# 3. Compute results
sum17 = cover2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=mask,
    scale=30,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get("treecover2000").getInfo()
sum22 = cover2022.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry=mask,
    scale=30,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get("treecover2000").getInfo()

# validation counts
count17 = cover2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=mask,
    scale=30,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get("treecover2000").getInfo()
count22 = cover2022.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=mask,
    scale=30,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get("treecover2000").getInfo()

print(f"2022 forest cover (ha): {sum22:.2f}, Valid pixels: {int(count22)}")
print(f"2017 forest cover (ha): {sum17:.2f}, Valid pixels: {int(count17)}")

# 4. Answer logic
if sum22 is None or sum17 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif count22 == 0 or count17 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif sum22 > sum17:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
